original.target_description: Verified Vul and Pashler (2008), study 1, crowd-within experiment. Supplied p. 1 (printed p. 645) contains separate paired comparisons of averaged versus first and second guesses in the immediate condition, plus the start of the delayed-condition comparison. The neutral description does not identify the condition or comparison.

replication.target_description: Verified Steegen et al. (2014) replication. Supplied p. 6 contains Table 4 with four distinct crowd-within paired tests (first/second guess, immediate/delayed), additional first-versus-second-guess tests, and between-condition tests. Neither condition nor comparison is specified by the locator.

n.sample_role: Target analytic sample cannot be selected uniquely.

reported_success.location: p. 6, opening paragraph of section 3.2 continuation
reported_success.quote: the current study can be considered as a successful replication of the crowd within effect, in both the immediate and the delayed condition.

notes: Both full primary papers were acquired and titles verified; neither is unavailable. Statistics are null because the supplied locators do not uniquely identify a target test, and no test was selected based on order. Original p. 645 prints immediate averaged-versus-first t(254) = 2.25, p < .05 and averaged-versus-second t(254) = 6.08, p < .01; delayed averaged-versus-first t(172) = 3.94, p < .01 continues onto p. 646. Original source: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/4920911be6f97b14d5062dc3.txt. Original reports 428 recruited participants overall, which is not a uniquely selected analytic n. Replication p. 6 Table 4 prints immediate guess 1: n = 471, t = 8.69, p <0.001; delayed guess 1: n = 140, t = 4.02, p <0.001; immediate guess 2: n = 471, t = 10.26, p <0.001; delayed guess 2: n = 140, t = 8.48, p <0.001. These are distinct candidate tests, not a combined effect. Replication p. 5 describes final participant samples after exclusions: immediate 484 minus 11 incomplete minus 2 reporting looked-up answers = printed final 471; delayed 171 returning minus 9 incomplete minus 21 browser-defocus minus 1 looked-up answers = printed final 140. Replication Table 1 notes corrected original t-values obtained from raw data; these do not replace values printed in the original paper. Replication source PDF includes an appended 2015 corrigendum about planned sample sizes; actual final samples are unchanged. Acquisition: original DOI landing returned 403, repository PDF route returned empty 202, open-access copy then succeeded; replication DOI full HTML and author-hosted PDF succeeded.
